title: ‘Possible Love’ tops Netflix in Korea through weekend
caption:
Local investors refused to back Lee Chang-dong's latest project for cinema screens. Netflix funded the three-hour labor strike drama, and domestic viewers instantly drove it to the very top of the charts.
